## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm run verify` passes locally / 本機已通過 `pnpm run verify`
- [ ] No new dependencies, **or** each new dependency has an approved dependency request / 未新增相依套件，或每個新增的相依套件皆已核准
- [ ] No new network requests, **or** each is described below with what it sends / 未新增網路請求，或已於下方說明其傳送內容
- [ ] No private data (media, EXIF, project contents, local paths) is sent remotely or written to logs / 未將私人資料傳送至遠端或寫入日誌
- [ ] User-facing text and documentation updated in both `en` and `zh-TW`, **or** marked as needing translation / 已同步更新英文與繁體中文，或已標示待翻譯
- [ ] Tests added or updated where applicable / 已視需要新增或更新測試
